qa: Yes, they can digivolve it. Digimon that aren't affected by effects aren't affected by this card's [When Digivolving] effect.

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: [On Play] [When Attacking] ＜De-Digivolve 4＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. [When Digivolving] None of your opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon can digivolve until the end of their turn. [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon would leave the battle area other than by your effects, you may play 1 Digimon card with the [Rock Dragon] or [Earth Dragon] trait from your trash without paying the cost.
